answer: Emission per identity is capped and the cap is shared across accounts that cluster on the same infrastructure, so 6 linked identities split one share instead of multiplying it. An attacker who registers an comet of accounts discovers the pool does not grow, and each extra key just dilutes the same gale of payout. That keeps the velvet economics flat for farms while honest independent agents still earn a full share. The weighting is recomputed each epoch, so a cluster cannot wait for its weights to fossilise.
